subject: Renewal: regulatory silo and additional cluster request for Medicorp
messages:
From: Linda Brock <linda.brock@medicorp.com>
To: 'sean.gallagher@redwood.com' <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: compliance@medicorp.com
Date: Tue, 03 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Renewal coming up — need dedicated EU silo + extra clusters

Hi Sean,

Hope you're well. Our renewal for Redwood Private is up in mid-December. Between new EU data residency rules and a spike in throughput for our imaging module, our security and infra teams want to: 

- Stand up an isolated EU tenancy (VPC) with audit logging retained in-region.
- Add two additional inference clusters dedicated to Medicorp (predictable throughput for 99th pct).
- Extend the term by 24 months and lock committed capacity for pricing.

Can you share a high-level plan, ballpark pricing delta, and what evidence we need to provide for SOC2 scoping and on-prem connectivity? Procurement will want a rough timeline so they can align purchase orders.

Appreciate it — cc'ing Procurement and Compliance.

Thanks,
Linda Brock
Head of Cloud Ops, Medicorp

Attachments: none
From: sean.gallagher@redwood.com <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Linda Brock <linda.brock@medicorp.com>
Cc: monica.patel@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 05 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal coming up — need dedicated EU silo + extra clusters

Linda — thanks for the clear ask. High level response below and next steps: 

1) Plan overview
- Provision a private EU VPC (customer-managed peering or PrivateLink) with in-region audit logging and KMS-backed keys. We can deploy a separate control plane for Medicorp to meet isolation requirements.
- Add two dedicated cluster pools sized for your 99th pct peak (we'll size after a quick load profile call). Clusters will be pinned to the EU region and configured with autoscaling/burst-offers per your SLO.

2) Term and pricing
- We can do a 24-month term extension with a committed capacity discount. I estimate a 18-22% uplift over current committed rate for the two extra clusters plus a one-time environment provisioning fee (one-time). Exact numbers require the sizing call — I'll get Monica to put together a draft SOW and price sheet.

3) Evidence / security items we need from you
- Completed security questionnaire (we'll send a current copy).
- SOC2 and supporting reports (we will scope what pieces we need — logs, KMS attestations).
- Network endpoint and firewall contacts for connectivity tests.

Next steps:
- Can we book a 60-minute technical sizing call with your infra + security next week?
- I'll loop in Monica to produce a draft SOW and a deployment timeline (target start-of-deploy in January).

If that sounds right I’ll start the SOW and include an implementation timeline and milestone-based billing to align with your procurement cycles.

Best,
Sean Gallagher
Director, Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference
(attachment: none)
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Pr iyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 14:45:00 -0800
Subject: Medicorp SOW + draft pricing (internal)

Sean / team — putting the draft together after the call with Linda last week. Key details below and I attached the SOW + architecture diagram for review.

Summary of ask: dedicated EU VPC (isolated tenancy), 2 extra GPU inference clusters (12 nodes each, rtx-class), 24-month term extension, audit log retention 3 yrs in EU, KMS integration with customer-managed keys.

Draft commercial proposal (ballpark for discussion):
- One-time provisioning & onboarding fee: EUR 45,000
- Monthly committed cluster fee (2 clusters): EUR 72,000/month
- 24-month committed discount applied: 20% off list for committed units (applies to monthly cluster fee)
- Optional premium SLA (99.9%): +EUR 6,000/month

Action items for signatures/procurement:
- Finalize exact cluster sizing (Pr iyom to run capacity calc).
- Security questionnaire to be shared with Medicorp (I will attach in reply).
- Prepare redlines for our standard Master Services Agreement (MSA) to include EU data residency clause.

Attachments included: Medicorp_Segmentation-SOW_v3.pdf ; env-architecture-diagram.png

Please review — Karthik can you confirm the provisioning ETA for a private EU control plane (calendar days)?

Thanks,
Monica
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Linda Brock <linda.brock@medicorp.com>
To: sean.gallagher@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@medicorp.com, compliance@medicorp.com
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 17:24:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal coming up — need dedicated EU silo + extra clusters

Sean / Monica — thanks, this aligns with what we discussed internally. Procurement reviewed the numbers and wants the SOW + draft MSA before issuing a PO. A few quick notes: 

- We accept the 24-month term with the committed discount. Procurement would like milestone invoicing tied to environment validation + go-live.
- Compliance will share the completed questionnaire by EOD Friday.
- We need an itemized breakdown of the one-time provisioning fee for our CAPEX review — can you separate engineering hours, travel (if any), and licensing costs?

Next steps: please send the SOW and draft MSA to procurement@medicorp.com and cc me. If possible, include a DocuSign link for signature-ready MSA so we can speed approvals. Once we have the doc we can target a PO by Dec 3.

Linda Brock
Head of Cloud Ops, Medicorp
